item.title: Podcast: AI Eats It All, Programar es una Mierda
item.author: marc.alier@upc.edu (Marc Alier)
item.description: Programar es una Mierda is a go-to podcast for talking about programming with love and humor. I think this is my third time on the show, and we always end up discussing interesting things. This time we talk about AI and programming.
